newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schenker says first with Palestine agent.
newsitem.headline: Schenker says first with Palestine agent.

text.p: Schenker International AG is the first international freight forwarder with a logistics partner in Palestine, parent company Schenker-Rhenus AG said.
Schenker is now represented in the autonomous Palestinian territory by Palestine Logistic Services (PLS), a company statement said.
The forwarder is a joint venture between Israeli freight forwarder Middle East Logistic Services (MELS), the local exclusive Schenker agent, and the Palestine autonomy authority, it added.
PLS, with offices in Gaza, Ramallah and the Allenby Bridge crossing to Jordan, offers air and sea cargo import and export services and land transport.
It will carry out all international and national transport and logistics tasks for the Palestine autonomy authority, Schenker said.
Joshua Podell, owner of MLS Transport, the MELS parent company, forecast that PLS would play a vital role helping to build up the future Palestinian state.
"Transport and logistics services are vital for the economy and growth for a land under construction," he said. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
